sources.note: ONC mandatory disclosures page. Describes SmartEMR as web-based EMR with CMS-compliant Superbill generation and claims processing. Certification details for v7.2.

SmartEMR homepage. Lists key features: e-Prescribing (Surescripts), lab integration (LabCorp, Quest), patient insurance eligibility, patient portal, electronic records exchange. Also references SmartEBS billing module.

FHIR R4 API documentation. Lists 16 supported FHIR resources (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, MedicationRequest, Observation, Organization, Practitioner, Procedure). OAuth 2.0 auth, SMART launch support.

SourceForge listing. Features include e-prescribing, HIPAA compliance, patient portal, appointment management, E/M coding, voice recognition, integrated telehealth, superbill generation. Zero user reviews.

FindEMR listing. Lists features: scheduling, lab management, advanced interpretations, billing, data mining module, drug database, e-prescribing with interaction checking, insurance claims. 1 review (5 stars). Notes customizable pricing tiers.
SoftwareFinder listing. Mentioned scheduling, lab management, advanced interpretations, billing, data mining, drug database, e-prescribing. Pricing not disclosed.
Company profile. Founded 2001, Miami FL, 11 employees, no recorded funding. Self-funded/bootstrapped.
ZoomInfo listing for VipaHealth Solutions. EMR, EHR, PHR, Billing Systems, Health Information Exchange, Healthcare Informatics.
MedicalRecords.com listing. Page rendered mostly as JavaScript; limited content extracted. Lists many supported specialties.
Apollo.io company profile. Estimates 11-50 employees and ~$24.6M revenue (likely inflated for company of this size).
SmartMBS domain now redirects to a domain parking page (HugeDomains). Product appears defunct or absorbed.
